games.name: SPECTER
games.desc:
Investigate ghosts in haunted locations with your friends. Use your equipment to find paranormal evidence and work out the ghost type, then escape before the ghost hunts you!

Use hiding spots to your advantage, and carefully control your stamina to survive the hunt. If you need more help, read the journal's FAQ section during a match, or check out our server.

⚠️ This game contains flashing lights, loud noises, and scary scenes.
⚙️ An extensive settings menu is available in the lobby! Customize your experience to your liking.
🎧 We recommend using headphones for the best experience.
🎙️ Spirit box and the team radio feature support voice chat!
🎵 The lobby music and ambient soundtracks used in SPECTER are original and copyright free, you are free to use them in videos!

Inspired by the horror game Phasmophobia.

games.name: 🎃 MEDIEVAL STRATEGY
games.desc:
⚔️ Compete for treasure to upgrade your kingdom! Recruit armies, defend your lands, and launch strategic attacks to conquer every opponent.

🎮 Game Controls & Basics:
- Choose a game mode and you’ll spawn at your castle.
- Right-click or tap on your castle and recruit a couple of builders.
- Click on a builder to select it and move them to a nearby farm.
- Build a Windmill near the farm to generate income.
- After building 3+ Windmills, build army structures (Barracks, Siege Workshop) and recruit units.
- Units auto-attack enemies. Destroy all enemy castles to win.

🏆 The game has matchmaking: level 1-5 and level 6+. "Ranked" mode unlocks after level 7
👍 Like the game to show support!
🔒 Private server owners are given access to various commands. (game pass)

games.name: [☃️XMAS ] Goalbound
games.desc:
Shift - Run
Space - Rainbow Flick
E - Tackle
E Mid-air - Intercept
Space + M1 - Header
Space + Space (IF BALL IS IN AIR) - Other Header 
M1 - Shoot
M1 + A/D - Curve shot
M1 + M2 - Shot feint
M1 + M2 Timed - Parry
M1 Timed - Volley shot(ball needs to be in the air)
Q - Dribble
T - Flow
G - Awaken 

⚽ Goalbound is a Roblox soccer game inspired by the anime Blue Lock, where players compete in intense 6v6 team-based matches to prove they're the best striker. With flashy skills, ego-driven gameplay, and training areas to sharpen your abilities, it captures the competitive, high-stakes spirit of Blue Lock in a fast-paced, anime-styled experience.

games.name: TIMELESS
games.desc:
During a violent outbreak in Robloxia, an Agency has been created to keep the remaining survivors safe. Your mission is to team up with your fellow emissaries to investigate dangerous areas. But be careful, and use your skills to your advantage.

TIMELESS is a 1v8 asymmetrical horror game that revolves around general Roblox media. The game takes big inspiration from The Disaster by OutLaikRBLX, and Left 4 Dead.
WARNING: This game contains flashing/bright lights

[KEYBINDS]:

[PC]
-Q, F, R, T : Using Abilities
-Left Control : Toggle ShiftLock
-V : Toggle POV
-R : Revive
-C : Carry
-G : Emote
-X : Open/Close chat wheel

[CONTROLLER]
-Y, L1, R1, L3 : Using Abilities
-L2 : Sprinting
-DPadUp : Toggle ShiftLock
-B : Revive
-DPadRight : Carry
-DPadDown : Emote
-X : Open/Close chat wheel

(Keybinds can be edited in settings)
